reader: Evaluator judging whether more visibility evaluation is proportionate; these costs are not usefulness scores and overlapping intervals are not summed.

initial_design_and_fixture_authoring.semantics: Work before the recorded preparation window was not timed.

recorded_preparation_window.semantics: Includes implementation, validation, dependency waiting and authentication troubleshooting; not active engineering time or the full implementation cost.

successful_launch_window.semantics: Includes gaps between launches for orchestration and inspection. Per-launch elapsed intervals are in observations.json.

outcome_grading.semantics: Verifier-reported wall interval for grading the eight outcome packets; not human attention measured by the collector.

fixation_review.semantics: Separate post-disclosure review completed before this observation; its start was not timed.

observed_synthesis_window.semantics: A partial recorded interval for synthesis and acceptance review; earlier analysis and later handoff are outside this window.

display_input_cost.semantics: Actual text, characters and UTF-8 bytes are recorded; no host attribution establishes exact added tokens per hook block.

collector_overhead.semantics: Live samples exclude process startup and final sample writes; the separate disabled-hook benchmark is not a live per-hook measurement.

failed_attempt.semantics: Sandbox authentication failure before model usage; retained as setup cost and replaced by a fresh elevated session.

clarification_delay.semantics: Inspection and operator status interruption extended the gap. Only the collect arm asked and received an answer; no matching display wait occurred. Not human attention.

plugin_and_initial_repository_validation.semantics: Full tests, metadata, Claude validation, Codex installation and both skill probes; exact active duration not captured. A sandbox DNS failure required an elevated Codex-check retry.

cold_cache_followup_validation.semantics: Duplicate documentation fixture packages reproduced on fresh Jest cache; root module indexing now excludes docs. Fresh-cache scripts passed without collision warnings, then the full repository suite passed; independently confirmed by verifier.
